title: Other dance halls he played on the west bank
summary: Russell asks about other halls; Valentine lists country clubs and halls he played for, and they agree there were many on that side of the river.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I remember ten years ago you used to play other places along there too.
Down Moore and Harvey, wasn't it? What were some of the other places you played?
Wasn't it down the road a little bit farther, away from the river, on the other side of the road, you played someplace?

Well I played, Mr. Bill, look I played, I played at Al J's Country Club way down low cove way in the back. Oh yeah. I played, I used to play for a fella by the river here, right by the river. I used to play for a fella, he had a dance hall. I played for him, Mr. Watney, he had a dance hall. I played for him and so many people I played for.
You played about all of them over there. Oh yeah, but a lot. There were a lot of dance halls on that side of the river, there still are. There were plenty of dance halls, see.
Oh I remember one night, I forgot I was going to ask you.
